# The Citric Acid Cycle

The Krebs cycle oxidizes acetyl-CoA in the mitochondrial matrix, producing NADH and FADH2 for oxidative phosphorylation.

## Cycle overview (pre-JSON figure)

```diagram
root((Citric Acid Cycle))
  Acetyl-CoA entry
    Oxaloacetate joins
    Citrate forms
  Oxidation steps
    NADH released
    FADH2 released
  Oxaloacetate regenerated
    Cycle repeats
```

## Why it matters

- Each glucose yields **two turns** of the cycle.
- The NADH feeds Complex I; the FADH2 feeds Complex II.
